# Quanttoria

> Private 1-on-1 online math tutoring for kids in Grades 1-10 in the United States. Live classes on an interactive whiteboard with a single teacher, Princy Sugandh (20,000+ teaching hours). The first class is free.

## What we teach
- Math for Grades 1-10: foundations, fractions and logic, pre-algebra, algebra and geometry
- Common Core and state standards, with a path toward AP Calculus and AP Statistics
- Goals: closing gaps, confidence and math anxiety, Olympiad and competitions, school homework
- Patient teaching, including for children who learn differently (parents of autistic students have reviewed her classes)

## Pricing
First class free. Plans: Grades 1-5 $300/month, Grades 6-8 $350/month, Grades 9-10 $400/month, each for 15 one-hour classes (about $20-27 each). 20% off when paid yearly.

## How it works
1. Tell us about your child (grade and goal) using the form on the home page.
2. Meet your teacher in a free, live 1:1 session. No credit card, no obligation.
3. Continue with regular classes and get clear feedback as a parent.
